title: King of Fighters '96, The (Japan) (1M): expansion-RAM compatibility
summary: Supply 1 MB expansion RAM and carry the matching upstream instruction edits into the disc read.
rationale: The original menu callback selected 1 MB cartridge mode and changed these loaded instructions. The bounded launch action is published only after the same pack passes sector preflight. This preserves both operations without changing the original image.

writes.effect: Apply the original kof96_patch instruction edit at 0605821C.
writes.reason: Preserve the matching built-in compatibility edit before the game loads this sector.
